stem.text: Citral is found in lemongrass oil. It can react to give compound **W**.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: citral (skeletal formula of an unsaturated aldehyde with two C=C bonds, labelled citral) reacts with an excess of H2/Ni to give V; V reacts with hot, concentrated acidified manganate(VII) under reflux to give W.
stem.label: citral

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched aldehyde: a CHO group at one end of the chain, a methyl branch, and a (CH3)2CH– group at the other end.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched carboxylic acid: a CO2H group at one end of the chain, a methyl branch, and a (CH3)2CH– group at the other end.
